RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Tuesday, August 2, 2011/Sravana 11, 1933 (Saka)
————
(Ministries : Drinking Water and Sanitation; Environment and Forests; Finance;
Health and Family Welfare; Heavy Industries and Public Enterprises;
Petroleum and Natural Gas; Rural Development)
Total number of questions — 20
Rise in prices of petro-products
*21. SHRI N. BALAGANGA: Will the
Minister of PETROLEUM AND
NATURAL GAS be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has increased
prices of petrol and diesel recently;
(b) the details of the break-up of prices
of petrol and diesel, based on refining
charges, duties, taxes, cess, etc.;
(c) whether oil companies are earning
undue profits at the cost of the common
man; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Destruction of mangrove forests
*22. SHRIMATI BRINDA KARA T:
Will the Minister of ENVIRONMENT
AND FORESTS be pleased to state:
(a) whether the Mundra Port Special
Economic Zone (SEZ) has destroyed vast
mangrove forests;
(b) whether it is a fact that the Mundra
Port SEZ has led to a large scale
displacement of traditional inter-tidal
fishing communities; and
(c) if so, the details thereof?
Linking of Ken and Betwa rivers
*23. SHRI BALWINDER SINGH
BHUNDER: Will the Minister of
ENVIRONMENT AND FORESTS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether the Ministry has opposed
the idea of linking the Ken and Betwa
rivers, under the River Linking Project;
(b) if so, the reasons therefor; and
(c) the views of the State Government
of Madhya Pradesh in this regard?
Provision of loan facility under
"Swabhimaan" campaign
†*24. SHRI MOTILAL VORA: Will
the Minister of  FINANCE  be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Central Government has
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

8
decided to extend banking facility to rural
areas under "Swabhimaan" campaign;
(b) if so, the number of villages where
this facility will be provided in the year
2010-11;
(c) whether loan at lower interest rate
will be made available to the small farmers
through the rural banks and what would
be the interest rate of such loan;
(d) whether the farmers who availed
loan relief during the period of UPA-I will
also be eligible for taking loans from these
rural banks; and
(e) the amount that was made available
for the indebted farmers during the period
from 2004-09 by UPA Government?
Calculation of inflation on
WPI basis
*25. SHRI RAMDAS AGARWAL:
Will the Minister of  FINANCE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Wholesale Price Index
(WPI) is used to calculate and decide the
inflation rate in the country;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether most of the developed
countries like United States, U.K., Japan,
France, etc. use the Consumer Price Index
(CPI) to calculate inflation;
(d) if  so, the reasons for not calculating
inflation on the basis of Consumer Price
Index (CPI) in the country; and
(e) whether India's top economists feel
that it is high time that India abandons
erroneous method of WPI and adopts
CPI to calculate inflation as is being
adopted in other developed countries of the
world?
Additional central assistance for
Urban Health Project in Gujarat
*26. SHRI BHARATSINH
PRABHATSINH PARMAR: Will the
Minister of HEALTH AND  FAMILY
WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has received
any proposal from the State Government
of Gujarat regarding additional central
assistance for Urban Health Project;
(b) if so, the present status of the
proposal;
(c) whether Government has decided to
sanction this project;
(d) if so, by when it is likely to be
finalised; and
(e) if not, the reasons therefor?
Study for estimating unaccounted
money
*27. SHRI D. RAJA: Will the Minister
of FINANCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
has commissioned a joint study by three
think tanks, namely, National Institute of
Public Finance and Policy (NIPFP),
National Institute of Financial
Management (NIFM) and the National
Council for Applied Economic Research
(NCAER), to estimate Indian entities'
unaccounted wealth, both at home and
abroad; and
(b) if so, the details thereof and by when
the study is expected to be completed?
Black money deposited in
Swiss  banks
*28. SHRI TARIQ ANWAR: Will the
Minister of FINANCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government

9
has received some information regarding
black money deposited in Swiss banks;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the steps Government is taking to
get back this money to the country?
CAG's observations on  MGNREGS in
Uttar Pradesh
†*29. SHRIMATI MAY A SINGH: Will
the Minister of RURAL DEVELOPMENT
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the
Comptroller and Auditor General (CAG)
has raised objections over methodology
adopted by the State Government of Uttar
Pradesh in Mahatma Gandhi National
Rural Employment Guarantee Scheme
(MGNREGS);
(b) if so, the objections raised by CAG
